free_text: The decision is to defer biopsy because the Panel Protocol was driven by the cohort criterion, which matched the reading urologist in 16 of 18 cases with a prior negative biopsy and a PI-RADS score of 3. Although the PSA velocity was high at 0.97 ng/mL/yr, the PI-RADS 3 score and the EAU guideline context regarding PSA density suggest deferral is appropriate. The evidence converged on deferral based on the cohort criterion, which was the decisive factor.
